runtime_fix.failure: ValueError: too many values to unpack (expected 2) at departure-indicator quicksum
runtime_fix.root_cause: mv is keyed by (mess_id, horizon_step, route_slot), but the departure-indicator generator unpacked each key as only (horizon_step, route_slot).
runtime_fix.repair: Iterate mv.items() with the exact 3-tuple key and filter by both mess_id and horizon_step.
runtime_fix.old_expression: depflag=gp.quicksum(mv[(mid,h,slot)] for (hh,slot) in mv if hh==h)
runtime_fix.new_expression: depflag=gp.quicksum(v for (m0,hh,slot),v in mv.items() if m0==mid and hh==h)
